scientific_integrity: Exact analytic proof of the covariance eigenspaces and strict least-eigenvalue transition; standalone checker supplies finite corroboration, not a proof for all dimensions.
scientific_limitations: The convex hull and uniform sampling use all nonempty connected-shore cut incidence vectors, excluding the zero cut. Some bond-polytope sources include the zero cut by convention, producing a different vertex measure. No statement about volume-uniform sampling, other graphs or weighted metrics. Priority is provisional; no independent validation.
title: Vertex-inertia spectrum and exponential principal-axis transition of nonempty biclique bond polytopes
